name: currency-transfer
title: Currency Transfer
description: A transfer receipt that follows money through four steps, rolls the amount into the new currency and offers a copyable reference.

props.name: from
props.description: Sending side: amount, currency, bank, optional symbol and last4.

props.name: to
props.description: Receiving side: amount, currency, bank, optional symbol, last4 and holder name.

props.name: rate
props.description: Units of the receiving currency per one unit of the sending currency.

props.name: txnId
props.description: Transaction reference, copyable from the footer.

props.name: status
props.description: Controlled status. Unset runs a self-completing demo (the finished state under reduced motion).

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for amounts, symbols and the rate.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Shows a Retry button when the transfer has failed.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
